label: FLUX.3 Image Klein turbo (step-distilled: text to image, and edit from reference images)

capabilities._note: flux3_klein's graph on the step-distilled checkpoint: one graph, both jobs (ReferenceMultiLatent, cut out with no references: flux3_klein/target.py), up to 10 references. 16 steps at cfg 1 with the negative zeroed, so no negative prompt; well over twice as fast as the base.

binding._note: An API graph built from ComfyUI's image_flux3_klein_distilled_image_edit.json (workflow templates 0.11.85), left out and replaced as flux3_klein's: the negative is the template's ConditioningZeroOut of the positive, KSampler 16 steps, cfg 1, euler/simple. The distilled text-to-image template's prompt upsampler is left out too.

models._note: As flux3_klein's, but the model is the step-distilled checkpoint (`_sd_` in BFL's file names).

presets._note: The distilled edit template's settings: 16 steps (it suggests 4-16), cfg 1, euler/simple.

downloads._note: As flux3_klein's: BFL's gated ComfyUI repo.
